unit: 产业放映 · 首作之上
rule: Use the next screening on the same date, in the same cinema and auditorium, across every programme. Add a post-screening discussion only if no later screening exists or the gap from the film ending to the next screening starting is at least 60 minutes (inclusive).
durationBasis: Use existing screeningEnds for that exact screening when present; otherwise use the recorded feature runtime. Thirty minutes follows the existing web and mini-program post-screening display. No guest identities inferred.
preserved: All 704 existing screening rows and sids, film runtimes, existing screening ends, QR codes, other programme screenings and industry admission restrictions.
